question: Which organisation expressed serious concerns about the potential escape of Ebola samples in Goma, Democratic Republic of Congo?

options.text: International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC)

solution:
The correct answer is __**International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The **International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC)** issued a grave warning in **February 2024** regarding the security of biological research facilities in the **Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC)**.

• The organization highlighted the risk of **Ebola virus samples** escaping from a laboratory in **Goma** due to the escalating conflict between the **M23 rebel group** and the **Congolese armed forces (FARDC)**.

• The specific facility at risk is the **National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB)** branch in **Goma**, which stores samples of highly contagious and deadly pathogens for diagnostic and research purposes.

• The **ICRC** emphasized that any damage to the laboratory's infrastructure or loss of power for cooling systems could lead to a secondary humanitarian disaster in the form of a **biological outbreak**.
